description: This file contains benchmark tests for the Abseil time library, specifically testing civil time functions such as difference calculation, formatting, parsing, and hashing of civil time objects.

methods.name: BM_Difference_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for calculating the difference in days between two civil days.

methods.name: BM_Step_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for incrementing a civil day object.

methods.name: BM_Format
methods.description: Benchmark for formatting a civil second time object into a string.

methods.name: BM_Parse
methods.description: Benchmark for parsing a string into a civil second time object.

methods.name: BM_RoundTripFormatParse
methods.description: Benchmark for formatting and then parsing a civil second time object.

methods.name: BM_CivilTimeAbslHash
methods.description: Template benchmark for hashing various civil time types.
